acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic promotion helper accepts an exact Work Item ID only after regular-file non-symlink archive Contract, verification evidence, unique sequence-2 deleted finalization head, and structured close receipt agree on repository identity, Work Item identity, Contract/evidence/finalization digests, merge revision, and terminal decision; missing, malformed, ambiguous, foreign, symlinked, or mismatched inputs fail closed without document writes.

Promotion changes only explicit machine-owned frontmatter/marker fields in the three exact Work Item documents and the one exact Work Item row in each tri-language reference-parity document; it never rewrites Contract-language prose or any immutable lifecycle evidence.

A check-only mode and mandatory documentation/quality gate reject any structurally closed governed Work Item whose controlled tri-language projections are absent, conditional, stale, ambiguous, duplicated, or not canonical for its persisted terminal evidence.

WI-253 tri-language Work Item and reference-parity projections are promoted to terminal Implemented truth by the helper and cite its exact archive, verification, sequence-2 finalization, close, and recovery evidence without modifying predecessor lifecycle bytes.

Tri-language lifecycle and command documentation state the required close → promote closed docs → terminal CI sequence, the deterministic controlled-write boundary, the fail-closed identity checks, and the manual-helper boundary rather than claiming Runtime Core mutates docs automatically.

After WI-254 is merged, sequence-2 finalized and structurally closed, the same helper promotes WI-254 from a detached synchronized default-branch closure context; check-only mode passes and terminal main CI is green without a further documentation successor.

Focused RED/GREEN regressions cover valid promotion plus wrong repository/Work Item/digest/finalization/close identity, missing counterpart/row, duplicate row, conditional stale projection, symlink, nonregular or malformed input, no-write failure, and idempotent check-only behavior; documentation acceptance, manifest route, fmt, clippy, full workspace, installed Runtime verify, hosted CI, and post-close terminal CI pass.
goal: Provide and gate one auditable helper that validates exact close/archive/evidence/finalization identity, promotes only machine-owned Work Item metadata and exact reference-parity rows, terminalizes WI-253 now, and is reused after WI-254 closes so terminal CI does not require another successor.
intent: Eliminate recursive stale documentation after a Work Item is structurally closed by adding a deterministic, fail-closed post-close promotion workflow that projects only verified terminal lifecycle truth into controlled tri-language documentation surfaces.
